# Forage Australia

> A free guide to wild food in Australia: which wild plants are in season in each state and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 48 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Warrigal greens](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/plants/warrigal/): Tetragonia tetragonioides; Warrigal greens, New Zealand spinach. In season September to April.
- [Old man saltbush](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/plants/saltbush/): Atriplex nummularia; Saltbush. In season all year round.
- [Pigface](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/plants/pigface/): Carpobrotus glaucescens; Pigface, Coastal pigface. In season December to March.
- [Lilly pilly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/plants/lillypilly/): Syzygium smithii; Lilly pilly, Riberry. In season February to June.
- [Finger lime](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/plants/fingerlime/): Citrus australasica; Finger lime, Caviar lime. In season December to May.
- [Davidson's plum](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/plants/davidson/): Davidsonia jerseyana; Davidson's plum. In season November to February.
- [Quandong](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/plants/quandong/): Santalum acuminatum; Quandong, Desert peach. In season September to December.
- [Muntries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/plants/muntries/): Kunzea pomifera; Muntries, Emu apple. In season January to March.

## Dishes

- [Lemon myrtle iced tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/lemon-myrtle-iced-tea/): Lemon myrtle leaves steeped, chilled, with honey.
- [Lilly pilly cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/lilly-pilly-cordial/): Berries simmered with sugar and lemon, strained.
- [Desert lime cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/desert-lime-cordial/): Whole desert limes cooked into a tangy cordial.
- [Kakadu plum juice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/kakadu-plum-juice/): Kakadu plum pulp blended with water and honey.
- [River mint tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/river-mint-tea/): Fresh river mint steeped in hot water.
- [Oysters with finger lime](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/oysters-with-finger-lime/): Fresh oysters topped with finger lime pearls.
- [Saltbush chips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/saltbush-chips/): Saltbush leaves fried crisp in light batter.
- [Roasted bunya nuts](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/roasted-bunya-nuts/): Boiled and roasted bunya nuts with salt.
- [Steamed mussels with river mint](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/steamed-mussels-with-river-mint/): Mussels steamed with garlic, white wine and native mint.
- [Davidson's plum jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/davidson-s-plum-jam/): Sour plums cooked with sugar into a deep red jam.
- [Quandong chutney](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/quandong-chutney/): Dried quandongs simmered with onion, vinegar and spice.
- [Warrigal greens pesto](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/warrigal-greens-pesto/): Blanched warrigal greens with macadamias, oil and cheese.
- [Pickled samphire](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/pickled-samphire/): Samphire tips in spiced vinegar.
- [Warrigal greens and feta pie](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/warrigal-greens-and-feta-pie/): Blanched greens in filo with feta and egg.
- [Saltbush lamb](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/saltbush-lamb/): Lamb rubbed with dried saltbush and pepperberry, roasted.
- [Bush tomato kangaroo](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/bush-tomato-kangaroo/): Kangaroo fillet with a bush tomato and pepperberry rub.
- [Wattleseed damper](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/wattleseed-damper/): Campfire bread made with roasted ground wattleseed.
- [Lemon myrtle shortbread](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/lemon-myrtle-shortbread/): Buttery shortbread scented with dried lemon myrtle.
- [Quandong pie](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/quandong-pie/): Outback classic of quandong halves in shortcrust.
- [Macadamia and wattleseed ice cream](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/macadamia-and-wattleseed-ice-cream/): Coffee-like wattleseed custard with toasted macadamias.
- [Muntrie crumble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/muntrie-crumble/): Spiced-apple muntries under an oat crumble.
- [Native tamarind cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/native-tamarind-cordial/): Tart orange arils simmered with sugar and strained.
- [Lemon aspen spritz](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/lemon-aspen-spritz/): Lemon aspen juice with soda and native mint.
- [Aniseed myrtle tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/aniseed-myrtle-tea/): Dried leaves steeped as a liquorice-scented tea.
- [Kangaroo skewers with riberry glaze](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/kangaroo-skewers-with-riberry-glaze/): Grilled kangaroo with a riberry and red wine glaze.
- [Oysters with lemon aspen](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/oysters-with-lemon-aspen/): Rock oysters with a lemon aspen dressing.
- [Illawarra plum sauce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/illawarra-plum-sauce/): Plums cooked with ginger and vinegar for duck and pork.
- [Riberry jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/riberry-jam/): Clove-scented riberries cooked into jam.
- [Sea celery salsa verde](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/sea-celery-salsa-verde/): Chopped sea celery with capers, lemon and oil.
- [Barramundi in native ginger leaf](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/barramundi-in-native-ginger-leaf/): Fish wrapped in native ginger leaves with lemon myrtle and grilled.
- [Witchetty grubs on coals](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/witchetty-grubs-on-coals/): Grubs cooked briefly on hot coals until golden.
- [Midyim berry muffins](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/midyim-berry-muffins/): Muffins studded with spicy midyim berries.
- [Boab pulp sherbet drink](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/boab-pulp-sherbet-drink/): Boab pulp whisked into water, a Kimberley treat.
- [Riberry and macadamia tart](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/riberry-and-macadamia-tart/): Tart of riberries over a macadamia frangipane.
- [Finger lime pavlova](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/finger-lime-pavlova/): Pavlova topped with cream and finger lime caviar.
- [Burdekin plum jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/burdekin-plum-jam/): Softened Burdekin plums cooked into a deep purple jam.
- [Strawberry gum iced tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/strawberry-gum-iced-tea/): Dried strawberry gum leaves steeped and chilled with honey.
- [Lemon tea tree tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/lemon-tea-tree-tea/): Fresh leaves steeped in hot water.
- [Native rosella jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/native-rosella-jam/): Hibiscus flowers cooked into a bright red jam.
- [Pipis in XO sauce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/pipis-in-xo-sauce/): Wok-fried pipis with XO sauce and spring onion.
- [Sea urchin on toast](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/sea-urchin-on-toast/): Fresh roe on buttered sourdough with lemon.
- [Seared abalone](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/seared-abalone/): Thinly sliced abalone seared in butter and garlic.
- [Pine mushrooms with garlic](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/pine-mushrooms-with-garlic/): Saffron milk caps fried with garlic, thyme and butter.
- [Slippery jack ragù](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/slippery-jack-rag/): Peeled slippery jacks cooked into a pasta sauce.
- [Munyeroo seed damper](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/munyeroo-seed-damper/): Damper made with ground purslane seed.
- [Home-cured olives](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/home-cured-olives/): Wild olives cured in brine for months.
- [Nasturtium capers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/nasturtium-capers/): Green nasturtium seeds pickled in vinegar.
- [Apple berry crumble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/au/dishes/apple-berry-crumble/): Ripe apple berries under an oat crumble.
